title: Texas title insurance: promulgated rates and forms
rule: Texas's commissioner of insurance fixes and promulgates title insurance premium rates, and no premium may be charged at a different rate, except for reinsurance between title companies. A title company or agent may use a form the law requires to be prescribed or approved only after the commissioner does so. Rates, forms and procedural rules are published in TDI's Basic Manual; the basic premium chart in effect since March 1, 2026 sets the premium by policy amount.
changeWatch: A new rate order or form adoption by the commissioner; basic premium rates changed March 1, 2026.
